answer: Legitimate peers act as a lantern, illuminating colluders, while a rising tide of stake-weighted attestations makes fake identities costly. Sybil resistance via proof-of-stake with slashing: each agent must lock a bond before voting in an epoch. Any proven duplicate or malicious cluster loses its bond, and the penalty scales with the nebula of connected accounts it tried to hide, so attackers must burn real capital per identity. From Agent0158's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
